text:
Ivy (People Ops): planning a small pilot: "Roam Recognition" 15 coffee e-gift + postcard for 200 remote folks. need approval on budget, shipping rules, and manager approval UX.
Marco (Logistics): postcard is good for intl. what's the ship vs e-delivery split?
Ivy (People Ops): prefer e-gift + optional postcard opt-in (mail only if opt-in). reduces customs/tax issues.
Elena (HRBP): managers should approve nominees by one-click. include note: cash payouts go through payroll.
Tom (Finance): budget ok for pilot. GL-6125 for culture spend. need final headcount to create PO.
Hari (Design): i'll do two postcard options and a secure shortlink QR for the e-card.
Nina (Intern): i can pull headcount + opt-ins and flag countries with mail blocks. will share csv.
Ivy (People Ops): timeline: opt-in survey close May 5, manager approvals May 10, vendor PO May 12, sends week of May 20.
Marco (Logistics): courier advice: mark physical as "promo goods" and require signature only where local rules demand.
Ivy (People Ops): action items: Nina: headcount + opt-ins by Fri; Hari: mockups Tue; Tom: PO draft by Mon; Elena: approve manager flow wording by Wed. cc @here when ready. :sparkles:
